The back and sides are mostly rosewood, mahogany or another hardwood, for structural stability and resonance. The neck is usually of horsehair-tree wood or walnut, giving durability and adequate strength. The four strings were traditionally nylon or steel wire, and modern versions mostly use nylon. The head and the frets are of hardwood or metal, so that the tuning is stable and lasts.
夸特羅是一種具有明亮、清脆音色的弦樂器，音質溫暖而富有穿透力。其音域集中在中高音: The cuatro is a string instrument with a bright, crisp timbre, warm in tone and carrying well. Its range is concentrated in the middle and upper register, and its timbre sits between the guitar and the ukulele, but with a warmer resonance. With its soundbox design it produces a full, resonant sound, so the timbre keeps its clarity and also has a genial quality. With few strings and moderate tension the cuatro has a particular intimacy; it is lighter and more agile than a standard guitar, but has more force and depth than a ukulele. Its resonance lets every note come through clearly, and in a folk band it supports the overall sound well, suiting traditional folk music.
夸特羅是源自拉丁美洲的傳統弦樂器，名稱在西班牙語中意為「四」，通常指其擁有四條弦: The cuatro is a traditional string instrument from Latin America; the name means "four" in Spanish, usually referring to its four strings. It is mainly current in Venezuela, Puerto Rico and other parts of the Caribbean. Its origin can be traced to the Spanish colonial period, where the Spanish guitar tradition met indigenous and African music. In Venezuela the cuatro plays an important part in folk music and has become the emblematic instrument of the local tradition. The Puerto Rican version developed separately within the island's musical tradition and shows a different timbre. Since the twentieth century, through folk performance and cultural exchange, the cuatro has gradually won recognition in Latin America and on the world music stage. Today it is an important symbol of Venezuelan and Puerto Rican cultural identity, and still plays a part in traditional song and folk performance.
